hero.eyebrow: DIGITAL TOOLS FOR YOUR EVERYDAY WORK
hero.title: JHON DANIEL
hero.subtitle: Digital solutions for your business
hero.meta: Websites · Automation · Tools made for you
hero.text: I help you get found online, save time, and manage your work more easily. I build websites, digital tools, and automations around the needs of your business.

services.title: More time for your work, fewer tasks to manage
services.intro: I build websites and easy-to-use tools that help you find customers, organize your work, and automate repetitive tasks.
services.card1Text: A clear, professional website that shows what you do and helps new customers find you.
services.card2Text: An easier way to organize customers, appointments, documents, and everyday tasks.
services.card3Text: I let the system handle repetitive tasks, so you save time and avoid mistakes.
services.card4Text: I connect the apps you already use, so you do not have to enter the same information more than once.
services.benefitsIntro: A website or digital tool should make a real difference: help people discover your business, lighten your workload, and make everyday tasks easier.
services.card5Title: Does it help you find customers?
services.card5Text: A structured online presence helps people find you, understand your business, and turn visitors into contacts.
services.card6Text: By automating repetitive processes and tasks, you can spend more time on what really matters.
services.card7Title: Does it make you look more professional?
services.card7Text: A polished online presence communicates credibility and shows the value of your business in the right way.
services.card8Text: I create tailored tools that reduce manual work, improve workflows, and make daily management easier.

solutions.title: Let's start with what you actually need.
solutions.techTitle: I choose the right tools for your project.
solutions.growthTitle: A journey that grows with you.
solutions.text: You do not need to know which technology to choose. Tell me how you work and what you would like to improve. I will find a straightforward way to help, whether that means a website, a tool to manage your work, or an everyday task that can be automated.
solutions.extra: We can start with one specific need and add more over time: online appointments, customer and document management, payments, or connecting the tools you use.
solutions.highlight: The goal is to help you work better with useful, easy-to-use tools made for your business.

about.title: A developer with a practical approach.
about.p1: I am Jhon Daniel, a Software Developer with around 5 years of experience. Throughout my career, I have worked on projects in different sectors, gaining experience in web and backend application development for companies and startups.
about.p2: I enjoy tackling real problems, working with motivated people, and finding concrete solutions that have a measurable impact on business.

experience.title: Technology serving real-world contexts.
experience.text: Throughout my career, I have contributed to software projects in different sectors, gaining experience developing digital solutions used in complex and structured environments.

lab.title: Discover what I can create
lab.intro: Here you can find small interactive demos of real solutions. Try them: click, enter data, and discover how they could work for your business.

security.title: Security is part of every project
security.lead: I think not only about what needs to work, but also about how to protect it.
security.text: From protecting data and access to input checks, spam and bot protection. Each solution is designed with layers of security suited to what it needs to handle.

lab.modalMessage: We are working on the new section.
